## Events
- [Percona Live 2026 \- Amsterdam](https://percona.stg.motiontactic.com/event/percona-live-2026-amsterdam/): Percona Live is where the open source database world shows up\. Join the people who build, run, scale, and fix data systems every day, and hear from them as they share real lessons, real challenges, and real success\.

Percona Live is not a marketing stage, vendor showcase, or corporate slide deck parade\. It is a conference for engineers, operators, architects, and database leaders who care about reliability, performance, and, most importantly, keeping open source open\.

If you run open source databases in the real world, this is your community – and your event\.

<script>
(() => {
const SEARCH_PAGE_URL = '/search/';
const searchClient = algoliasearch('QPF6EL892Z', 'd92f1cb96d524984195dc62f6da70008');
const resultsPerTab = 10; // top N per source; the full list lives on the search page

const DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT = 1560; // below this width the input drops under the header

const container = document.getElementById('topbar-search');
const popupEl = document.getElementById('search-popup');
const inputWrap = document.getElementById('search-input-wrap');
const iconBtn = document.getElementById('search-icon-btn');
const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('search-collapse-btn');
const seeAllLink = document.getElementById('see-all-link');
const summaryEl = document.getElementById('popup-summary');
const liveRegion = document.getElementById('search-live');

let activeIndex = -1;

/* ---- per-tab hit counts + auto-switch ------------------------------- */

const TAB_INFO = {
  results1: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-main'), label: 'Main site' },
  results3: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-blog'), label: 'Percona Blog' },
  results2: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-docs'), label: 'Documentation' },
  results4: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-community-blog'), label: 'Community Blog' },
};
// visual tab order
const TAB_ORDER = ['results1', 'results3', 'results4', 'results2'];

const hitCounts = { results1: null, results2: null, results3: null, results4: null };
let lastQuery = '';
let userChoseTab = false; // true once the user manually picks a tab for the current query

function activePanelId() {
  const p = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return p ? p.id : 'results1';
}

function updateFooter() {
  const ready = TAB_ORDER.every(id => hitCounts[id] != null);
  const total = ready ? TAB_ORDER.reduce((s, id) => s + hitCounts[id], 0) : null;
  const id = activePanelId();
  const n = hitCounts[id];

  if (n == null || n === 0) {
    summaryEl.textContent = '';
  } else {
    const shown = Math.min(n, resultsPerTab);
    summaryEl.textContent = n > shown
      ? 'Top ' + shown + ' of ' + n.toLocaleString() + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label
      : n.toLocaleString() + ' result' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label;
  }

  seeAllLink.innerHTML = total
    ? 'See all ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' results →'
    : 'See all results →';
}

function updateTabLabels() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => {
    const { tab, label } = TAB_INFO[id];
    const n = hitCounts[id];
    if (n == null) {
      tab.textContent = label;
    } else {
      tab.innerHTML = '';
      tab.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label + ' '));
      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'tab-count';
      count.textContent = '(' + n.toLocaleString() + ')';
      tab.appendChild(count);
    }
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('no-results', n === 0);
  });
  updateFooter();
}

function resetCounts() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => { hitCounts[id] = null; });
  updateTabLabels();
}

// connectStats-based widget: records nbHits for one index/panel
const makeStatsWidget = (panelId) =>
  instantsearch.connectors.connectStats((renderOptions, isFirstRender) => {
    if (isFirstRender) return; // skip the dummy initial render
    hitCounts[panelId] = renderOptions.nbHits;
    updateTabLabels();
  })({});

// If the active tab is empty but another has results, switch to the first
// (in visual order) that does — unless the user picked a tab for this query.
function maybeAutoSwitch() {
  if (userChoseTab) return;
  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (TAB_ORDER.some(id => hitCounts[id] == null)) return; // wait for all counts

  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  if (!activePanel || (hitCounts[activePanel.id] || 0) > 0) return;

  const target = TAB_ORDER.find(id => hitCounts[id] > 0);
  if (!target || target === activePanel.id) return;

  const fromLabel = TAB_INFO[activePanel.id].label;
  const toLabel = TAB_INFO[target].label;
  activateTab(TAB_INFO[target].tab);
  if (liveRegion) {
    liveRegion.textContent = 'No results in ' + fromLabel + '. Showing ' + toLabel + ' results.';
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function isDropdownMode() {
  return window.innerWidth < DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT;
}

function updateDropPositions() {
  if (!isDropdownMode()) return;
  const headerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dropTop = Math.max(headerRect.bottom + 24, 24);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-drop-top', dropTop + 'px');

  // popup goes below the input bar (measure it if visible, otherwise estimate)
  const wrapH = container.classList.contains('expanded')
    ? inputWrap.getBoundingClientRect().height
    : 56;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-popup-top', (dropTop + wrapH + 8) + 'px');
}

let rafPending = false;
function scheduleReposition() {
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    rafPending = false;
    updateDropPositions();
  });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleReposition);
window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleReposition, { passive: true });

function goToSearchPage(query) {
  window.location.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query);
}

const search = instantsearch({
  indexName: 'percona_main_site',
  searchClient,
  searchFunction(helper) {
    const q = helper.state.query.trim();
    if (q === '') {
      closePopup();
      resetCounts();
      return;
    }
    seeAllLink.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
    openPopup();
    helper.search();
  }
});

search.addWidgets([
  instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({
    container: '#searchbox',
    placeholder: 'Search percona.com...',
  })
]);

function hitTemplate(hit) {
  const img = hit.image ? `<div class="c_img"><img src="${hit.image}" alt=""></div>` : '';
  return `
<a class="hit-link" href="${hit.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
${img}
<div class="c_body">
<div class="row1">${hit.title}</div>
<div class="c_desc">${hit.description || ''}</div>
</div>
</a>`;
}

function sourceIndex(indexName, panelId) {
  return instantsearch.widgets.index({ indexName }).addWidgets([
    instantsearch.widgets.configure({ hitsPerPage: resultsPerTab }),
    instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#' + panelId + ' .hits', templates: { item: hitTemplate } }),
    makeStatsWidget(panelId),
  ]);
}

search.addWidgets([
  sourceIndex('percona_main_site', 'results1'),
  sourceIndex('percona_docs_pages', 'results2'),
  sourceIndex('percona_blog_articles', 'results3'),
  sourceIndex('percona_community_blog_pages', 'results4'),
]);

search.on('render', () => {
  clearActive();
  scheduleReposition();

  // new query: reset the "user picked a tab" pin and scroll lists to the top
  const q = (search.helper ? search.helper.state.query : '').trim();
  if (q !== lastQuery) {
    lastQuery = q;
    userChoseTab = false;
    popupEl.querySelectorAll('.results').forEach(r => { r.scrollTop = 0; });
  }
  if (q !== '') maybeAutoSwitch();
});

search.start();

function getInput() {
  return container.querySelector('.ais-SearchBox-input');
}

function openPopup() {
  updateDropPositions();
  popupEl.classList.add('open');
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
}

function closePopup() {
  popupEl.classList.remove('open');
  clearActive();
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function setupCombobox() {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input) return;
  input.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  input.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'search-popup');
  input.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');
  input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Search percona.com');
}
setupCombobox();

function visibleHitLinks() {
  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return activePanel ? Array.from(activePanel.querySelectorAll('.hit-link')) : [];
}

function clearActive() {
  activeIndex = -1;
  popupEl.querySelectorAll('.hit-link.is-active').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('is-active');
    el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
  });
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
}

function setActive(index, opts = {}) {
  const { scroll = true } = opts;
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  if (!links.length) return;
  activeIndex = (index + links.length) % links.length;
  links.forEach((el, i) => {
    const on = i === activeIndex;
    el.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
    if (on) {
      if (!el.id) el.id = 'hit-option-' + i;
      el.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      // keyboard nav keeps the highlighted row inside the scroll area;
      // hovering must not scroll, or the list jumps under the pointer
      if (scroll) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      const input = getInput();
      if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', el.id);
    } else {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
    }
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab, { byUser: true }));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const tabsArr = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab'));
    const i = tabsArr.indexOf(tab);
    let next = null;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next = tabsArr[(i + 1) % tabsArr.length];
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = tabsArr[(i - 1 + tabsArr.length) % tabsArr.length];
    if (next) {
      e.preventDefault();
      next.focus();
      activateTab(next, { byUser: true });
    }
  });
});

function activateTab(tab, opts = {}) {
  if (opts.byUser) userChoseTab = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(t => {
    t.classList.remove('active');
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    t.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .results').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
  tab.classList.add('active');
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  const panel = document.getElementById(tab.dataset.target);
  panel.classList.add('active');
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
  clearActive();
  updateFooter();
}

function expandSearch() {
  updateDropPositions();
  container.classList.add('expanded');
  const delay = isDropdownMode() ? 0 : 260;
  setTimeout(() => {
    // the wrap is laid out by now, so measure it for real — measuring too
    // early estimated 56px and let the popup slide under the input bar,
    // hiding the tab row and the first hit
    updateDropPositions();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) {
      input.focus();
      if (input.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
    }
  }, delay);
}

// focusIcon: only when the user deliberately dismissed the search (close
// button, Escape, icon toggle). On an outside click focus belongs wherever
// they clicked, so don't yank it back to the header.
function collapseSearch(opts = {}) {
  const { focusIcon = true } = opts;
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) {
    input.value = '';
    search.helper.setQuery('').search();
  }
  closePopup();
  container.classList.remove('expanded');
  if (focusIcon) iconBtn.focus();
}

iconBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (isDropdownMode() && container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  } else {
    expandSearch();
  }
});
collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => collapseSearch());

container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input || e.target !== input) return;

  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const links = visibleHitLinks();
    if (popupEl.classList.contains('open') && activeIndex >= 0 && links[activeIndex]) {
      links[activeIndex].click();
    } else {
      const q = input.value.trim();
      if (q !== '') goToSearchPage(q);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex - 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'Home' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(0);
  } else if (e.key === 'End' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(visibleHitLinks().length - 1);
  }
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const link = e.target.closest('.hit-link');
  if (!link) {
    if (activeIndex !== -1) clearActive();
    return;
  }
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  const i = links.indexOf(link);
  if (i !== -1 && i !== activeIndex) setActive(i, { scroll: false });
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  clearActive();
});

document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (container.contains(e.target) && e.target.matches('.ais-SearchBox-input')) {
    if (e.target.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
  }
});

/* Outside-click close. composedPath() is captured at dispatch time, so it
   still works if a re-render detaches the clicked node before the event
   bubbles here; the pointerdown flag is a fallback for older browsers. */
let pressedInside = false;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  pressedInside = container.contains(e.target);
}, true);

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : null;
  const inside = path ? path.includes(container) : container.contains(e.target);
  if (inside || pressedInside) return;

  // full collapse, not just closePopup() — leaving the expanded input bar
  // behind puts it on top of whatever nav menu the user just opened
  if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
  else closePopup();
});

// keyboard equivalent: tabbing or focusing into a nav menu also dismisses it
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (!container.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
  if (container.contains(e.target)) return;
  collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
  if (popupEl.classList.contains('open')) {
    closePopup();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) input.focus();
  } else if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  }
});
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
const SEARCH_PAGE_URL = '/search/';
const searchClient = algoliasearch('QPF6EL892Z', 'd92f1cb96d524984195dc62f6da70008');
const resultsPerTab = 10; // top N per source; the full list lives on the search page

const DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT = 1560; // below this width the input drops under the header

const container = document.getElementById('topbar-search');
const popupEl = document.getElementById('search-popup');
const inputWrap = document.getElementById('search-input-wrap');
const iconBtn = document.getElementById('search-icon-btn');
const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('search-collapse-btn');
const seeAllLink = document.getElementById('see-all-link');
const summaryEl = document.getElementById('popup-summary');
const liveRegion = document.getElementById('search-live');

let activeIndex = -1;

/* ---- per-tab hit counts + auto-switch ------------------------------- */

const TAB_INFO = {
  results1: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-main'), label: 'Main site' },
  results3: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-blog'), label: 'Percona Blog' },
  results2: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-docs'), label: 'Documentation' },
  results4: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-community-blog'), label: 'Community Blog' },
};
// visual tab order
const TAB_ORDER = ['results1', 'results3', 'results4', 'results2'];

const hitCounts = { results1: null, results2: null, results3: null, results4: null };
let lastQuery = '';
let userChoseTab = false; // true once the user manually picks a tab for the current query

function activePanelId() {
  const p = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return p ? p.id : 'results1';
}

function updateFooter() {
  const ready = TAB_ORDER.every(id => hitCounts[id] != null);
  const total = ready ? TAB_ORDER.reduce((s, id) => s + hitCounts[id], 0) : null;
  const id = activePanelId();
  const n = hitCounts[id];

  if (n == null || n === 0) {
    summaryEl.textContent = '';
  } else {
    const shown = Math.min(n, resultsPerTab);
    summaryEl.textContent = n > shown
      ? 'Top ' + shown + ' of ' + n.toLocaleString() + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label
      : n.toLocaleString() + ' result' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label;
  }

  seeAllLink.innerHTML = total
    ? 'See all ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' results →'
    : 'See all results →';
}

function updateTabLabels() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => {
    const { tab, label } = TAB_INFO[id];
    const n = hitCounts[id];
    if (n == null) {
      tab.textContent = label;
    } else {
      tab.innerHTML = '';
      tab.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label + ' '));
      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'tab-count';
      count.textContent = '(' + n.toLocaleString() + ')';
      tab.appendChild(count);
    }
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('no-results', n === 0);
  });
  updateFooter();
}

function resetCounts() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => { hitCounts[id] = null; });
  updateTabLabels();
}

// connectStats-based widget: records nbHits for one index/panel
const makeStatsWidget = (panelId) =>
  instantsearch.connectors.connectStats((renderOptions, isFirstRender) => {
    if (isFirstRender) return; // skip the dummy initial render
    hitCounts[panelId] = renderOptions.nbHits;
    updateTabLabels();
  })({});

// If the active tab is empty but another has results, switch to the first
// (in visual order) that does — unless the user picked a tab for this query.
function maybeAutoSwitch() {
  if (userChoseTab) return;
  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (TAB_ORDER.some(id => hitCounts[id] == null)) return; // wait for all counts

  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  if (!activePanel || (hitCounts[activePanel.id] || 0) > 0) return;

  const target = TAB_ORDER.find(id => hitCounts[id] > 0);
  if (!target || target === activePanel.id) return;

  const fromLabel = TAB_INFO[activePanel.id].label;
  const toLabel = TAB_INFO[target].label;
  activateTab(TAB_INFO[target].tab);
  if (liveRegion) {
    liveRegion.textContent = 'No results in ' + fromLabel + '. Showing ' + toLabel + ' results.';
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function isDropdownMode() {
  return window.innerWidth < DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT;
}

function updateDropPositions() {
  if (!isDropdownMode()) return;
  const headerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dropTop = Math.max(headerRect.bottom + 24, 24);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-drop-top', dropTop + 'px');

  // popup goes below the input bar (measure it if visible, otherwise estimate)
  const wrapH = container.classList.contains('expanded')
    ? inputWrap.getBoundingClientRect().height
    : 56;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-popup-top', (dropTop + wrapH + 8) + 'px');
}

let rafPending = false;
function scheduleReposition() {
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    rafPending = false;
    updateDropPositions();
  });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleReposition);
window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleReposition, { passive: true });

function goToSearchPage(query) {
  window.location.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query);
}

const search = instantsearch({
  indexName: 'percona_main_site',
  searchClient,
  searchFunction(helper) {
    const q = helper.state.query.trim();
    if (q === '') {
      closePopup();
      resetCounts();
      return;
    }
    seeAllLink.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
    openPopup();
    helper.search();
  }
});

search.addWidgets([
  instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({
    container: '#searchbox',
    placeholder: 'Search percona.com...',
  })
]);

function hitTemplate(hit) {
  const img = hit.image ? `<div class="c_img"><img src="${hit.image}" alt=""></div>` : '';
  return `
<a class="hit-link" href="${hit.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
${img}
<div class="c_body">
<div class="row1">${hit.title}</div>
<div class="c_desc">${hit.description || ''}</div>
</div>
</a>`;
}

function sourceIndex(indexName, panelId) {
  return instantsearch.widgets.index({ indexName }).addWidgets([
    instantsearch.widgets.configure({ hitsPerPage: resultsPerTab }),
    instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#' + panelId + ' .hits', templates: { item: hitTemplate } }),
    makeStatsWidget(panelId),
  ]);
}

search.addWidgets([
  sourceIndex('percona_main_site', 'results1'),
  sourceIndex('percona_docs_pages', 'results2'),
  sourceIndex('percona_blog_articles', 'results3'),
  sourceIndex('percona_community_blog_pages', 'results4'),
]);

search.on('render', () => {
  clearActive();
  scheduleReposition();

  // new query: reset the "user picked a tab" pin and scroll lists to the top
  const q = (search.helper ? search.helper.state.query : '').trim();
  if (q !== lastQuery) {
    lastQuery = q;
    userChoseTab = false;
    popupEl.querySelectorAll('.results').forEach(r => { r.scrollTop = 0; });
  }
  if (q !== '') maybeAutoSwitch();
});

search.start();

function getInput() {
  return container.querySelector('.ais-SearchBox-input');
}

function openPopup() {
  updateDropPositions();
  popupEl.classList.add('open');
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
}

function closePopup() {
  popupEl.classList.remove('open');
  clearActive();
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function setupCombobox() {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input) return;
  input.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  input.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'search-popup');
  input.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');
  input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Search percona.com');
}
setupCombobox();

function visibleHitLinks() {
  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return activePanel ? Array.from(activePanel.querySelectorAll('.hit-link')) : [];
}

function clearActive() {
  activeIndex = -1;
  popupEl.querySelectorAll('.hit-link.is-active').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('is-active');
    el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
  });
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
}

function setActive(index, opts = {}) {
  const { scroll = true } = opts;
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  if (!links.length) return;
  activeIndex = (index + links.length) % links.length;
  links.forEach((el, i) => {
    const on = i === activeIndex;
    el.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
    if (on) {
      if (!el.id) el.id = 'hit-option-' + i;
      el.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      // keyboard nav keeps the highlighted row inside the scroll area;
      // hovering must not scroll, or the list jumps under the pointer
      if (scroll) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      const input = getInput();
      if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', el.id);
    } else {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
    }
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab, { byUser: true }));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const tabsArr = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab'));
    const i = tabsArr.indexOf(tab);
    let next = null;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next = tabsArr[(i + 1) % tabsArr.length];
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = tabsArr[(i - 1 + tabsArr.length) % tabsArr.length];
    if (next) {
      e.preventDefault();
      next.focus();
      activateTab(next, { byUser: true });
    }
  });
});

function activateTab(tab, opts = {}) {
  if (opts.byUser) userChoseTab = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(t => {
    t.classList.remove('active');
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    t.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .results').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
  tab.classList.add('active');
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  const panel = document.getElementById(tab.dataset.target);
  panel.classList.add('active');
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
  clearActive();
  updateFooter();
}

function expandSearch() {
  updateDropPositions();
  container.classList.add('expanded');
  const delay = isDropdownMode() ? 0 : 260;
  setTimeout(() => {
    // the wrap is laid out by now, so measure it for real — measuring too
    // early estimated 56px and let the popup slide under the input bar,
    // hiding the tab row and the first hit
    updateDropPositions();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) {
      input.focus();
      if (input.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
    }
  }, delay);
}

// focusIcon: only when the user deliberately dismissed the search (close
// button, Escape, icon toggle). On an outside click focus belongs wherever
// they clicked, so don't yank it back to the header.
function collapseSearch(opts = {}) {
  const { focusIcon = true } = opts;
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) {
    input.value = '';
    search.helper.setQuery('').search();
  }
  closePopup();
  container.classList.remove('expanded');
  if (focusIcon) iconBtn.focus();
}

iconBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (isDropdownMode() && container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  } else {
    expandSearch();
  }
});
collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => collapseSearch());

container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input || e.target !== input) return;

  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const links = visibleHitLinks();
    if (popupEl.classList.contains('open') && activeIndex >= 0 && links[activeIndex]) {
      links[activeIndex].click();
    } else {
      const q = input.value.trim();
      if (q !== '') goToSearchPage(q);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex - 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'Home' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(0);
  } else if (e.key === 'End' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(visibleHitLinks().length - 1);
  }
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const link = e.target.closest('.hit-link');
  if (!link) {
    if (activeIndex !== -1) clearActive();
    return;
  }
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  const i = links.indexOf(link);
  if (i !== -1 && i !== activeIndex) setActive(i, { scroll: false });
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  clearActive();
});

document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (container.contains(e.target) && e.target.matches('.ais-SearchBox-input')) {
    if (e.target.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
  }
});

/* Outside-click close. composedPath() is captured at dispatch time, so it
   still works if a re-render detaches the clicked node before the event
   bubbles here; the pointerdown flag is a fallback for older browsers. */
let pressedInside = false;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  pressedInside = container.contains(e.target);
}, true);

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : null;
  const inside = path ? path.includes(container) : container.contains(e.target);
  if (inside || pressedInside) return;

  // full collapse, not just closePopup() — leaving the expanded input bar
  // behind puts it on top of whatever nav menu the user just opened
  if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
  else closePopup();
});

// keyboard equivalent: tabbing or focusing into a nav menu also dismisses it
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (!container.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
  if (container.contains(e.target)) return;
  collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
  if (popupEl.classList.contains('open')) {
    closePopup();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) input.focus();
  } else if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  }
});
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
const SEARCH_PAGE_URL = '/search/';
const searchClient = algoliasearch('QPF6EL892Z', 'd92f1cb96d524984195dc62f6da70008');
const resultsPerTab = 10; // top N per source; the full list lives on the search page

const DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT = 1560; // below this width the input drops under the header

const container = document.getElementById('topbar-search');
const popupEl = document.getElementById('search-popup');
const inputWrap = document.getElementById('search-input-wrap');
const iconBtn = document.getElementById('search-icon-btn');
const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('search-collapse-btn');
const seeAllLink = document.getElementById('see-all-link');
const summaryEl = document.getElementById('popup-summary');
const liveRegion = document.getElementById('search-live');

let activeIndex = -1;

/* ---- per-tab hit counts + auto-switch ------------------------------- */

const TAB_INFO = {
  results1: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-main'), label: 'Main site' },
  results3: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-blog'), label: 'Percona Blog' },
  results2: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-docs'), label: 'Documentation' },
  results4: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-community-blog'), label: 'Community Blog' },
};
// visual tab order
const TAB_ORDER = ['results1', 'results3', 'results4', 'results2'];

const hitCounts = { results1: null, results2: null, results3: null, results4: null };
let lastQuery = '';
let userChoseTab = false; // true once the user manually picks a tab for the current query

function activePanelId() {
  const p = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return p ? p.id : 'results1';
}

function updateFooter() {
  const ready = TAB_ORDER.every(id => hitCounts[id] != null);
  const total = ready ? TAB_ORDER.reduce((s, id) => s + hitCounts[id], 0) : null;
  const id = activePanelId();
  const n = hitCounts[id];

  if (n == null || n === 0) {
    summaryEl.textContent = '';
  } else {
    const shown = Math.min(n, resultsPerTab);
    summaryEl.textContent = n > shown
      ? 'Top ' + shown + ' of ' + n.toLocaleString() + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label
      : n.toLocaleString() + ' result' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label;
  }

  seeAllLink.innerHTML = total
    ? 'See all ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' results →'
    : 'See all results →';
}

function updateTabLabels() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => {
    const { tab, label } = TAB_INFO[id];
    const n = hitCounts[id];
    if (n == null) {
      tab.textContent = label;
    } else {
      tab.innerHTML = '';
      tab.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label + ' '));
      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'tab-count';
      count.textContent = '(' + n.toLocaleString() + ')';
      tab.appendChild(count);
    }
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('no-results', n === 0);
  });
  updateFooter();
}

function resetCounts() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => { hitCounts[id] = null; });
  updateTabLabels();
}

// connectStats-based widget: records nbHits for one index/panel
const makeStatsWidget = (panelId) =>
  instantsearch.connectors.connectStats((renderOptions, isFirstRender) => {
    if (isFirstRender) return; // skip the dummy initial render
    hitCounts[panelId] = renderOptions.nbHits;
    updateTabLabels();
  })({});

// If the active tab is empty but another has results, switch to the first
// (in visual order) that does — unless the user picked a tab for this query.
function maybeAutoSwitch() {
  if (userChoseTab) return;
  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (TAB_ORDER.some(id => hitCounts[id] == null)) return; // wait for all counts

  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  if (!activePanel || (hitCounts[activePanel.id] || 0) > 0) return;

  const target = TAB_ORDER.find(id => hitCounts[id] > 0);
  if (!target || target === activePanel.id) return;

  const fromLabel = TAB_INFO[activePanel.id].label;
  const toLabel = TAB_INFO[target].label;
  activateTab(TAB_INFO[target].tab);
  if (liveRegion) {
    liveRegion.textContent = 'No results in ' + fromLabel + '. Showing ' + toLabel + ' results.';
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function isDropdownMode() {
  return window.innerWidth < DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT;
}

function updateDropPositions() {
  if (!isDropdownMode()) return;
  const headerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dropTop = Math.max(headerRect.bottom + 24, 24);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-drop-top', dropTop + 'px');

  // popup goes below the input bar (measure it if visible, otherwise estimate)
  const wrapH = container.classList.contains('expanded')
    ? inputWrap.getBoundingClientRect().height
    : 56;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-popup-top', (dropTop + wrapH + 8) + 'px');
}

let rafPending = false;
function scheduleReposition() {
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    rafPending = false;
    updateDropPositions();
  });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleReposition);
window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleReposition, { passive: true });

function goToSearchPage(query) {
  window.location.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query);
}

const search = instantsearch({
  indexName: 'percona_main_site',
  searchClient,
  searchFunction(helper) {
    const q = helper.state.query.trim();
    if (q === '') {
      closePopup();
      resetCounts();
      return;
    }
    seeAllLink.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
    openPopup();
    helper.search();
  }
});

search.addWidgets([
  instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({
    container: '#searchbox',
    placeholder: 'Search percona.com...',
  })
]);

function hitTemplate(hit) {
  const img = hit.image ? `<div class="c_img"><img src="${hit.image}" alt=""></div>` : '';
  return `
<a class="hit-link" href="${hit.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
${img}
<div class="c_body">
<div class="row1">${hit.title}</div>
<div class="c_desc">${hit.description || ''}</div>
</div>
</a>`;
}

function sourceIndex(indexName, panelId) {
  return instantsearch.widgets.index({ indexName }).addWidgets([
    instantsearch.widgets.configure({ hitsPerPage: resultsPerTab }),
    instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#' + panelId + ' .hits', templates: { item: hitTemplate } }),
    makeStatsWidget(panelId),
  ]);
}

search.addWidgets([
  sourceIndex('percona_main_site', 'results1'),
  sourceIndex('percona_docs_pages', 'results2'),
  sourceIndex('percona_blog_articles', 'results3'),
  sourceIndex('percona_community_blog_pages', 'results4'),
]);

search.on('render', () => {
  clearActive();
  scheduleReposition();

  // new query: reset the "user picked a tab" pin and scroll lists to the top
  const q = (search.helper ? search.helper.state.query : '').trim();
  if (q !== lastQuery) {
    lastQuery = q;
    userChoseTab = false;
    popupEl.querySelectorAll('.results').forEach(r => { r.scrollTop = 0; });
  }
  if (q !== '') maybeAutoSwitch();
});

search.start();

function getInput() {
  return container.querySelector('.ais-SearchBox-input');
}

function openPopup() {
  updateDropPositions();
  popupEl.classList.add('open');
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
}

function closePopup() {
  popupEl.classList.remove('open');
  clearActive();
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function setupCombobox() {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input) return;
  input.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  input.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'search-popup');
  input.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');
  input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Search percona.com');
}
setupCombobox();

function visibleHitLinks() {
  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return activePanel ? Array.from(activePanel.querySelectorAll('.hit-link')) : [];
}

function clearActive() {
  activeIndex = -1;
  popupEl.querySelectorAll('.hit-link.is-active').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('is-active');
    el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
  });
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
}

function setActive(index, opts = {}) {
  const { scroll = true } = opts;
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  if (!links.length) return;
  activeIndex = (index + links.length) % links.length;
  links.forEach((el, i) => {
    const on = i === activeIndex;
    el.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
    if (on) {
      if (!el.id) el.id = 'hit-option-' + i;
      el.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      // keyboard nav keeps the highlighted row inside the scroll area;
      // hovering must not scroll, or the list jumps under the pointer
      if (scroll) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      const input = getInput();
      if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', el.id);
    } else {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
    }
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab, { byUser: true }));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const tabsArr = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab'));
    const i = tabsArr.indexOf(tab);
    let next = null;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next = tabsArr[(i + 1) % tabsArr.length];
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = tabsArr[(i - 1 + tabsArr.length) % tabsArr.length];
    if (next) {
      e.preventDefault();
      next.focus();
      activateTab(next, { byUser: true });
    }
  });
});

function activateTab(tab, opts = {}) {
  if (opts.byUser) userChoseTab = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(t => {
    t.classList.remove('active');
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    t.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .results').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
  tab.classList.add('active');
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  const panel = document.getElementById(tab.dataset.target);
  panel.classList.add('active');
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
  clearActive();
  updateFooter();
}

function expandSearch() {
  updateDropPositions();
  container.classList.add('expanded');
  const delay = isDropdownMode() ? 0 : 260;
  setTimeout(() => {
    // the wrap is laid out by now, so measure it for real — measuring too
    // early estimated 56px and let the popup slide under the input bar,
    // hiding the tab row and the first hit
    updateDropPositions();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) {
      input.focus();
      if (input.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
    }
  }, delay);
}

// focusIcon: only when the user deliberately dismissed the search (close
// button, Escape, icon toggle). On an outside click focus belongs wherever
// they clicked, so don't yank it back to the header.
function collapseSearch(opts = {}) {
  const { focusIcon = true } = opts;
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) {
    input.value = '';
    search.helper.setQuery('').search();
  }
  closePopup();
  container.classList.remove('expanded');
  if (focusIcon) iconBtn.focus();
}

iconBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (isDropdownMode() && container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  } else {
    expandSearch();
  }
});
collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => collapseSearch());

container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input || e.target !== input) return;

  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const links = visibleHitLinks();
    if (popupEl.classList.contains('open') && activeIndex >= 0 && links[activeIndex]) {
      links[activeIndex].click();
    } else {
      const q = input.value.trim();
      if (q !== '') goToSearchPage(q);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex - 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'Home' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(0);
  } else if (e.key === 'End' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(visibleHitLinks().length - 1);
  }
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const link = e.target.closest('.hit-link');
  if (!link) {
    if (activeIndex !== -1) clearActive();
    return;
  }
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  const i = links.indexOf(link);
  if (i !== -1 && i !== activeIndex) setActive(i, { scroll: false });
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  clearActive();
});

document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (container.contains(e.target) && e.target.matches('.ais-SearchBox-input')) {
    if (e.target.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
  }
});

/* Outside-click close. composedPath() is captured at dispatch time, so it
   still works if a re-render detaches the clicked node before the event
   bubbles here; the pointerdown flag is a fallback for older browsers. */
let pressedInside = false;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  pressedInside = container.contains(e.target);
}, true);

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : null;
  const inside = path ? path.includes(container) : container.contains(e.target);
  if (inside || pressedInside) return;

  // full collapse, not just closePopup() — leaving the expanded input bar
  // behind puts it on top of whatever nav menu the user just opened
  if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
  else closePopup();
});

// keyboard equivalent: tabbing or focusing into a nav menu also dismisses it
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (!container.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
  if (container.contains(e.target)) return;
  collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
  if (popupEl.classList.contains('open')) {
    closePopup();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) input.focus();
  } else if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  }
});
})();
</script>

<style>

/* result count inside the tab pill */

<script>
(() => {
const SEARCH_PAGE_URL = '/search/';
const searchClient = algoliasearch('QPF6EL892Z', 'd92f1cb96d524984195dc62f6da70008');
const resultsPerTab = 10; // top N per source; the full list lives on the search page

const DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT = 1560; // below this width the input drops under the header

const container = document.getElementById('topbar-search');
const popupEl = document.getElementById('search-popup');
const inputWrap = document.getElementById('search-input-wrap');
const iconBtn = document.getElementById('search-icon-btn');
const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('search-collapse-btn');
const seeAllLink = document.getElementById('see-all-link');
const summaryEl = document.getElementById('popup-summary');
const liveRegion = document.getElementById('search-live');

let activeIndex = -1;

/* ---- per-tab hit counts + auto-switch ------------------------------- */

const TAB_INFO = {
  results1: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-main'), label: 'Main site' },
  results3: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-blog'), label: 'Percona Blog' },
  results2: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-docs'), label: 'Documentation' },
  results4: { tab: document.getElementById('tab-community-blog'), label: 'Community Blog' },
};
// visual tab order
const TAB_ORDER = ['results1', 'results3', 'results4', 'results2'];

const hitCounts = { results1: null, results2: null, results3: null, results4: null };
let lastQuery = '';
let userChoseTab = false; // true once the user manually picks a tab for the current query

function activePanelId() {
  const p = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return p ? p.id : 'results1';
}

function updateFooter() {
  const ready = TAB_ORDER.every(id => hitCounts[id] != null);
  const total = ready ? TAB_ORDER.reduce((s, id) => s + hitCounts[id], 0) : null;
  const id = activePanelId();
  const n = hitCounts[id];

  if (n == null || n === 0) {
    summaryEl.textContent = '';
  } else {
    const shown = Math.min(n, resultsPerTab);
    summaryEl.textContent = n > shown
      ? 'Top ' + shown + ' of ' + n.toLocaleString() + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label
      : n.toLocaleString() + ' result' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in ' + TAB_INFO[id].label;
  }

  seeAllLink.innerHTML = total
    ? 'See all ' + total.toLocaleString() + ' results →'
    : 'See all results →';
}

function updateTabLabels() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => {
    const { tab, label } = TAB_INFO[id];
    const n = hitCounts[id];
    if (n == null) {
      tab.textContent = label;
    } else {
      tab.innerHTML = '';
      tab.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label + ' '));
      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'tab-count';
      count.textContent = '(' + n.toLocaleString() + ')';
      tab.appendChild(count);
    }
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('no-results', n === 0);
  });
  updateFooter();
}

function resetCounts() {
  TAB_ORDER.forEach(id => { hitCounts[id] = null; });
  updateTabLabels();
}

// connectStats-based widget: records nbHits for one index/panel
const makeStatsWidget = (panelId) =>
  instantsearch.connectors.connectStats((renderOptions, isFirstRender) => {
    if (isFirstRender) return; // skip the dummy initial render
    hitCounts[panelId] = renderOptions.nbHits;
    updateTabLabels();
  })({});

// If the active tab is empty but another has results, switch to the first
// (in visual order) that does — unless the user picked a tab for this query.
function maybeAutoSwitch() {
  if (userChoseTab) return;
  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (TAB_ORDER.some(id => hitCounts[id] == null)) return; // wait for all counts

  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  if (!activePanel || (hitCounts[activePanel.id] || 0) > 0) return;

  const target = TAB_ORDER.find(id => hitCounts[id] > 0);
  if (!target || target === activePanel.id) return;

  const fromLabel = TAB_INFO[activePanel.id].label;
  const toLabel = TAB_INFO[target].label;
  activateTab(TAB_INFO[target].tab);
  if (liveRegion) {
    liveRegion.textContent = 'No results in ' + fromLabel + '. Showing ' + toLabel + ' results.';
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function isDropdownMode() {
  return window.innerWidth < DROPDOWN_BREAKPOINT;
}

function updateDropPositions() {
  if (!isDropdownMode()) return;
  const headerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dropTop = Math.max(headerRect.bottom + 24, 24);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-drop-top', dropTop + 'px');

  // popup goes below the input bar (measure it if visible, otherwise estimate)
  const wrapH = container.classList.contains('expanded')
    ? inputWrap.getBoundingClientRect().height
    : 56;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--search-popup-top', (dropTop + wrapH + 8) + 'px');
}

let rafPending = false;
function scheduleReposition() {
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    rafPending = false;
    updateDropPositions();
  });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleReposition);
window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleReposition, { passive: true });

function goToSearchPage(query) {
  window.location.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query);
}

const search = instantsearch({
  indexName: 'percona_main_site',
  searchClient,
  searchFunction(helper) {
    const q = helper.state.query.trim();
    if (q === '') {
      closePopup();
      resetCounts();
      return;
    }
    seeAllLink.href = SEARCH_PAGE_URL + '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q);
    openPopup();
    helper.search();
  }
});

search.addWidgets([
  instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({
    container: '#searchbox',
    placeholder: 'Search percona.com...',
  })
]);

function hitTemplate(hit) {
  const img = hit.image ? `<div class="c_img"><img src="${hit.image}" alt=""></div>` : '';
  return `
<a class="hit-link" href="${hit.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
${img}
<div class="c_body">
<div class="row1">${hit.title}</div>
<div class="c_desc">${hit.description || ''}</div>
</div>
</a>`;
}

function sourceIndex(indexName, panelId) {
  return instantsearch.widgets.index({ indexName }).addWidgets([
    instantsearch.widgets.configure({ hitsPerPage: resultsPerTab }),
    instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#' + panelId + ' .hits', templates: { item: hitTemplate } }),
    makeStatsWidget(panelId),
  ]);
}

search.addWidgets([
  sourceIndex('percona_main_site', 'results1'),
  sourceIndex('percona_docs_pages', 'results2'),
  sourceIndex('percona_blog_articles', 'results3'),
  sourceIndex('percona_community_blog_pages', 'results4'),
]);

search.on('render', () => {
  clearActive();
  scheduleReposition();

  // new query: reset the "user picked a tab" pin and scroll lists to the top
  const q = (search.helper ? search.helper.state.query : '').trim();
  if (q !== lastQuery) {
    lastQuery = q;
    userChoseTab = false;
    popupEl.querySelectorAll('.results').forEach(r => { r.scrollTop = 0; });
  }
  if (q !== '') maybeAutoSwitch();
});

search.start();

function getInput() {
  return container.querySelector('.ais-SearchBox-input');
}

function openPopup() {
  updateDropPositions();
  popupEl.classList.add('open');
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
}

function closePopup() {
  popupEl.classList.remove('open');
  clearActive();
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function setupCombobox() {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input) return;
  input.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  input.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'search-popup');
  input.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
  input.setAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');
  input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Search percona.com');
}
setupCombobox();

function visibleHitLinks() {
  const activePanel = popupEl.querySelector('.results.active');
  return activePanel ? Array.from(activePanel.querySelectorAll('.hit-link')) : [];
}

function clearActive() {
  activeIndex = -1;
  popupEl.querySelectorAll('.hit-link.is-active').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('is-active');
    el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
  });
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
}

function setActive(index, opts = {}) {
  const { scroll = true } = opts;
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  if (!links.length) return;
  activeIndex = (index + links.length) % links.length;
  links.forEach((el, i) => {
    const on = i === activeIndex;
    el.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
    if (on) {
      if (!el.id) el.id = 'hit-option-' + i;
      el.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      // keyboard nav keeps the highlighted row inside the scroll area;
      // hovering must not scroll, or the list jumps under the pointer
      if (scroll) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      const input = getInput();
      if (input) input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', el.id);
    } else {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-selected');
    }
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(tab => {
  tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab, { byUser: true }));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const tabsArr = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab'));
    const i = tabsArr.indexOf(tab);
    let next = null;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next = tabsArr[(i + 1) % tabsArr.length];
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = tabsArr[(i - 1 + tabsArr.length) % tabsArr.length];
    if (next) {
      e.preventDefault();
      next.focus();
      activateTab(next, { byUser: true });
    }
  });
});

function activateTab(tab, opts = {}) {
  if (opts.byUser) userChoseTab = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .tab').forEach(t => {
    t.classList.remove('active');
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    t.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.search-popup .results').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
  tab.classList.add('active');
  tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  tab.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  const panel = document.getElementById(tab.dataset.target);
  panel.classList.add('active');
  panel.scrollTop = 0;
  clearActive();
  updateFooter();
}

function expandSearch() {
  updateDropPositions();
  container.classList.add('expanded');
  const delay = isDropdownMode() ? 0 : 260;
  setTimeout(() => {
    // the wrap is laid out by now, so measure it for real — measuring too
    // early estimated 56px and let the popup slide under the input bar,
    // hiding the tab row and the first hit
    updateDropPositions();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) {
      input.focus();
      if (input.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
    }
  }, delay);
}

// focusIcon: only when the user deliberately dismissed the search (close
// button, Escape, icon toggle). On an outside click focus belongs wherever
// they clicked, so don't yank it back to the header.
function collapseSearch(opts = {}) {
  const { focusIcon = true } = opts;
  const input = getInput();
  if (input) {
    input.value = '';
    search.helper.setQuery('').search();
  }
  closePopup();
  container.classList.remove('expanded');
  if (focusIcon) iconBtn.focus();
}

iconBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (isDropdownMode() && container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  } else {
    expandSearch();
  }
});
collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => collapseSearch());

container.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const input = getInput();
  if (!input || e.target !== input) return;

  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const links = visibleHitLinks();
    if (popupEl.classList.contains('open') && activeIndex >= 0 && links[activeIndex]) {
      links[activeIndex].click();
    } else {
      const q = input.value.trim();
      if (q !== '') goToSearchPage(q);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (!popupEl.classList.contains('open')) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(activeIndex - 1);
  } else if (e.key === 'Home' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(0);
  } else if (e.key === 'End' && activeIndex >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(visibleHitLinks().length - 1);
  }
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const link = e.target.closest('.hit-link');
  if (!link) {
    if (activeIndex !== -1) clearActive();
    return;
  }
  const links = visibleHitLinks();
  const i = links.indexOf(link);
  if (i !== -1 && i !== activeIndex) setActive(i, { scroll: false });
});

popupEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  clearActive();
});

document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (container.contains(e.target) && e.target.matches('.ais-SearchBox-input')) {
    if (e.target.value.trim() !== '') openPopup();
  }
});

/* Outside-click close. composedPath() is captured at dispatch time, so it
   still works if a re-render detaches the clicked node before the event
   bubbles here; the pointerdown flag is a fallback for older browsers. */
let pressedInside = false;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  pressedInside = container.contains(e.target);
}, true);

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : null;
  const inside = path ? path.includes(container) : container.contains(e.target);
  if (inside || pressedInside) return;

  // full collapse, not just closePopup() — leaving the expanded input bar
  // behind puts it on top of whatever nav menu the user just opened
  if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
  else closePopup();
});

// keyboard equivalent: tabbing or focusing into a nav menu also dismisses it
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
  if (!container.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
  if (container.contains(e.target)) return;
  collapseSearch({ focusIcon: false });
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
  if (popupEl.classList.contains('open')) {
    closePopup();
    const input = getInput();
    if (input) input.focus();
  } else if (container.classList.contains('expanded')) {
    collapseSearch();
  }
});
})();
</script>
